newsitem.title: ESTONIA: FOREKSPANK 1996 GROUP PROFIT 46.1 MLN KROONS.
newsitem.headline: FOREKSPANK 1996 GROUP PROFIT 46.1 MLN KROONS.

text.p: Forekspank on Monday said that its 1996 group profit was 46.13 million kroons compared with a 1995 group profit of 12.94 million kroons.
The bank said in a statement that the profit per share was 11.3 kroons.
Group income was 159.09 million kroons compared with the 1995 income of 86.57 million kroons.
The bank also said that assets rose to 1.45 billion kroons from 721.56 million kroons.
Total deposits rose to 978.35 million kroons from 484.04 million kroons.
Net lending rose to 443.91 million kroons from 206.17 million kroons.
Net interest income grew to 44.33 million kroons from 23.04 million kroons while income from commissions rose to 36.29 million kroons from 24.87 million kroons.
Income from forex operations rose to 42.19 million kroons from 26.89 million kroons and income from investments rose to 22.58 million kroons from 3.67 million kroons.
